text: BRAINSTORM (tags, 2 providers). codex: typed semantic tags (role/weight/source/priority), Tag-Map=Concept-Index node, handles <tag>/<verb-object>. opus (PICK): TWO-TIER — declared COLORED facets (area/phase/risk, reuse milestone_kinds idiom) + free UNCOLORED topics (long tail). Primary facet=essence headline→tints node, names task handle, names .md file (fixes opaque sec_<uuid>.md too). Tags invert by mode: Tile=substitute body / Card=accompany digest / Document=recede to header. Tag-Map=HUD legend+filter, no n2 edges. Authored via .md front-matter (live watcher). Synthesized → design §19.

Design decision: implement tags and handles as stored plan fields plus deterministic normalization before every write/read. Handles remain aliases (ids stay authoritative) and externalized body filenames derive from handle with id fallback for migration, so existing uuid .md files hydrate once and rewrite under readable handle names.

Implemented core schema pass: Task.priority, task timestamps, Section/Task tags+handles, Plan.tag_facets, handle-based markdown filenames with front-matter tag parsing, and initial CLI/RPC surfaces. Continuing through tests and manifest.
